title: Blaming Yourself Gets In The Way Of Your Healing Process
text: something critical you have to understand and I know this runs through people's veins it's blaming yourself blaming yourself for any kind of adversity and any kind of struggle it's blaming yourself okay now when it comes down to health issues if you're struggling with a symptom depression multiple sclerosis nausea anxiety seizures whatever it is we covered a lot of stuff CFS whatever it is it's not your fault I can promise you it's not your fault you have to remember that this critical and don't forget it it gets in the way of your healing process when you believe it's your fault it interferes it messes with your mind that messes with your soul if you're sick you're sick and it's not your fault something happened and it's about discovering why and how to correct it and move forward because your body loves you unconditionally and it wants to heal your body wants to heal and it loves you unconditionally and you can't forget that you cannot forget that [Music] don't forget that and you're not a bad person you didn't create your symptoms you didn't create your doctor bills you didn't create your compromises from being sick you didn't create your emotional pain and you didn't create your losses you have to remember that and don't forget this pat yourself on the back have compassion for yourself critical critical I know that it's not your fault that you're sick or have a chronic illness or a symptom I know I need you I know I know SOC knows but I need you to know [Music]
